browser: Chrome with the user's injected EIP-1193 wallet

connect_and_disconnect.detail: Disconnected and reconnected through the live navbar; the same injected account was displayed.

connected_wallet_menu.detail: Menu displayed full address, Copy address, Studionet · 61999, Studionet explorer link, and Disconnect.

refresh_recovery.detail: After connecting on /migrations/4, reloading kept the same address and Studionet · 61999 status.

wrong_network_and_switch_to_61999.detail: The injected wallet was already on Studionet 61999. The browser-control policy blocked chrome://extensions and explicitly disallowed reaching wallet extension controls by an alternate route.

account_change.detail: Changing the selected injected-wallet account requires wallet extension UI, which was not available through the permitted browser controls.

limitation: Wallet state was verified only on the already-selected account and correct chain. Wrong-network handling, switching chains, and accountChanged were not exercised; no browser or application state was faked.
